ext.description: View Ollama Cloud usage and quota limits in VS Code.
cmd.setUsagePrecision: Ollama Cloud: Set Usage Display Precision
config.title: Ollama Cloud Usage
config.refreshInterval: Auto-refresh interval in seconds (10–86400). All VS Code windows share one usage cache, so fresh data is not re-fetched.
config.usagePrecision: Decimal places for the usage percentage (0–4, default 1). Display only — does not affect requests.
config.language: UI language. Defaults to following VS Code's display language.
